changeSet.comment: Add two beds to every physical room under an admission location
changeSet.sql:
INSERT INTO bed (bed_number, status, bed_type_id, uuid, creator, date_created, voided) SELECT CONCAT( CASE room.uuid WHEN '9212680d-bb7c-412a-bd07-d24358f5a4ad' THEN 'URG' WHEN '046a84ac-cd6a-4725-b712-24cb115d1c55' THEN 'GEN-H1' WHEN '6f9ad5d9-bcfe-45fb-82b1-c48bf6ae051f' THEN 'GEN-H2' WHEN 'df352801-7c6c-4dd5-bbef-0c01a216d453' THEN 'PED-H1' ELSE CONCAT('SALA-', LEFT(room.uuid, 8)) END, '-', slot.suffix ), 'AVAILABLE', NULL, UUID(), 1, NOW(), FALSE FROM location room JOIN location ward ON ward.location_id = room.parent_location AND ward.retired = FALSE JOIN location_tag_map room_tag_map ON room_tag_map.location_id = room.location_id JOIN location_tag room_tag ON room_tag.location_tag_id = room_tag_map.location_tag_id AND room_tag.name = 'Admission Location' JOIN location_tag_map ward_tag_map ON ward_tag_map.location_id = ward.location_id JOIN location_tag ward_tag ON ward_tag.location_tag_id = ward_tag_map.location_tag_id AND ward_tag.name = 'Admission Location' JOIN ( SELECT '01' AS suffix, 1 AS bed_row_number, 1 AS bed_column_number UNION ALL SELECT '02', 1, 2 ) slot ON 1 = 1 WHERE room.retired = FALSE AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM bed_location_map occupied_position WHERE occupied_position.location_id = room.location_id AND occupied_position.bed_row_number = slot.bed_row_number AND occupied_position.bed_column_number = slot.bed_column_number AND occupied_position.bed_id IS NOT NULL ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM bed existing_bed WHERE existing_bed.bed_number = CONCAT( CASE room.uuid WHEN '9212680d-bb7c-412a-bd07-d24358f5a4ad' THEN 'URG' WHEN '046a84ac-cd6a-4725-b712-24cb115d1c55' THEN 'GEN-H1' WHEN '6f9ad5d9-bcfe-45fb-82b1-c48bf6ae051f' THEN 'GEN-H2' WHEN 'df352801-7c6c-4dd5-bbef-0c01a216d453' THEN 'PED-H1' ELSE CONCAT('SALA-', LEFT(room.uuid, 8)) END, '-', slot.suffix ) AND existing_bed.voided = FALSE );
INSERT INTO bed_location_map (location_id, bed_row_number, bed_column_number, bed_id) SELECT room.location_id, slot.bed_row_number, slot.bed_column_number, bed.bed_id FROM location room JOIN location ward ON ward.location_id = room.parent_location AND ward.retired = FALSE JOIN location_tag_map room_tag_map ON room_tag_map.location_id = room.location_id JOIN location_tag room_tag ON room_tag.location_tag_id = room_tag_map.location_tag_id AND room_tag.name = 'Admission Location' JOIN location_tag_map ward_tag_map ON ward_tag_map.location_id = ward.location_id JOIN location_tag ward_tag ON ward_tag.location_tag_id = ward_tag_map.location_tag_id AND ward_tag.name = 'Admission Location' JOIN ( SELECT '01' AS suffix, 1 AS bed_row_number, 1 AS bed_column_number UNION ALL SELECT '02', 1, 2 ) slot ON 1 = 1 JOIN bed ON bed.bed_number = CONCAT( CASE room.uuid WHEN '9212680d-bb7c-412a-bd07-d24358f5a4ad' THEN 'URG' WHEN '046a84ac-cd6a-4725-b712-24cb115d1c55' THEN 'GEN-H1' WHEN '6f9ad5d9-bcfe-45fb-82b1-c48bf6ae051f' THEN 'GEN-H2' WHEN 'df352801-7c6c-4dd5-bbef-0c01a216d453' THEN 'PED-H1' ELSE CONCAT('SALA-', LEFT(room.uuid, 8)) END, '-', slot.suffix ) AND bed.voided = FALSE WHERE room.retired = FALSE AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM bed_location_map existing_mapping WHERE existing_mapping.location_id = room.location_id AND existing_mapping.bed_id = bed.bed_id );

changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO concept_name (concept_id, name, locale, locale_preferred, creator, date_created, concept_name_type, voided, uuid) SELECT c.concept_id, names.name, 'es', FALSE, 1, NOW(), names.concept_name_type, FALSE, UUID() FROM concept c JOIN ( SELECT '1114AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA' AS concept_uuid, 'Vital signs' AS name, 'FULLY_SPECIFIED' AS concept_name_type UNION ALL SELECT '1114AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA', 'Signos vitales', 'SHORT' UNION ALL SELECT 'da47a35d-5806-48b7-b467-e29902759491', 'Chief Complaint Record', 'FULLY_SPECIFIED' UNION ALL SELECT 'da47a35d-5806-48b7-b467-e29902759491', 'Motivo de consulta', 'SHORT' UNION ALL SELECT '9bb0795c-4ff0-0305-1990-000000000046', 'Patient Instructions', 'FULLY_SPECIFIED' UNION ALL SELECT '9bb0795c-4ff0-0305-1990-000000000046', 'Indicaciones para el paciente', 'SHORT' UNION ALL SELECT '9bb0795c-4ff0-0305-1990-000000000047', 'Referral Entry', 'FULLY_SPECIFIED' UNION ALL SELECT '9bb0795c-4ff0-0305-1990-000000000047', 'Derivacion', 'SHORT' UNION ALL SELECT '9bb0795c-4ff0-0305-1990-000000000006', 'Consultation Images', 'FULLY_SPECIFIED' UNION ALL SELECT '9bb0795c-4ff0-0305-1990-000000000006', 'Imagenes de consulta', 'SHORT' UNION ALL SELECT '9bb0795c-4ff0-0305-1990-000000000029', 'Consultation Videos', 'FULLY_SPECIFIED' UNION ALL SELECT '9bb0795c-4ff0-0305-1990-000000000029', 'Videos de consulta', 'SHORT' ) names ON names.concept_uuid = c.uuid WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM concept_name existing_name WHERE existing_name.concept_id = c.concept_id AND existing_name.name = names.name AND existing_name.locale = 'es' AND existing_name.concept_name_type = names.concept_name_type AND existing_name.voided = FALSE );

changeSet.author: HealthMesh
changeSet.comment: Add Spanish names to root concepts that are provided by the base dictionary
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO concept_name (concept_id, name, locale, locale_preferred, creator, date_created, concept_name_type, voided, uuid) SELECT c.concept_id, names.es_name, 'es', FALSE, 1, NOW(), names.concept_name_type, FALSE, UUID() FROM concept c JOIN concept_name en_name ON en_name.concept_id = c.concept_id JOIN ( SELECT 'Lab Samples' AS lookup_name, 'Lab Samples' AS es_name, 'FULLY_SPECIFIED' AS concept_name_type UNION ALL SELECT 'Lab Samples', 'Muestras de laboratorio', 'SHORT' UNION ALL SELECT 'Lab Departments', 'Lab Departments', 'FULLY_SPECIFIED' UNION ALL SELECT 'Lab Departments', 'Departamentos de laboratorio', 'SHORT' UNION ALL SELECT 'Specimen Sample Source', 'Specimen Sample Source', 'FULLY_SPECIFIED' UNION ALL SELECT 'Specimen Sample Source', 'Origen de muestra', 'SHORT' UNION ALL SELECT 'Consultation Note', 'Consultation Note', 'FULLY_SPECIFIED' UNION ALL SELECT 'Consultation Note', 'Nota de consulta', 'SHORT' ) names ON names.lookup_name = en_name.name WHERE c.retired = FALSE AND en_name.locale = 'en' AND en_name.concept_name_type = 'FULLY_SPECIFIED' AND en_name.voided = FALSE AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM concept_name existing_name WHERE existing_name.concept_id = c.concept_id AND existing_name.name = names.es_name AND existing_name.locale = 'es' AND existing_name.concept_name_type = names.concept_name_type AND existing_name.voided = FALSE );
